tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: Get a competitive multi-aggregator swap quote with ready-to-execute calldata. PaladinFi does not represent any returned route as the best available across the broader DeFi market.

tools.name: trust_check_preview
tools.description:
Get a SAMPLE-FIXTURE preview of the PaladinFi token-contract trust check.

⚠️ NOT a real evaluation. Returns fixed sample data with `_preview: true`,
every factor marked `real: false`, and recommendation prefixed `sample-`
(`sample-allow` / `sample-warn` / `sample-block`). Use this for shape-testing

tools.name: swap_health
tools.description: Return the swap router's health + configuration (fee recipient, bps, supported chains).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "trust_check_preview" is 2215 chars, far longer than this server's median (179). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trust_check_preview · Private data: trust_check_preview · Public sink: trust_check_preview · Destructive: swap_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trust_check_preview · Private data: trust_check_preview · Public sink: trust_check_preview · Destructive: swap_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
